title: Piercing Frame Trio #004 (가슴 컷 · [일반·P25 집중형·공예(Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye)·메이크업 우즈벡실크로드글램] ; [일반·P50 정의형·공예(Turkish İznik tile)·메이크업 스페인플라멩코글램] ; [맥시·P50 정의형·이레즈미·체형 amazon bombshell])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, bust shot. THREE women standing side by side, each facing the camera straight on, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible, framed from the very top of their heads to just below their chests, the frame cutting off beneath the chests. Every face sits large and sharp in the upper half of the frame, and every woman's ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Uzbek woman — a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, soft pastel-peach hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge silver segment ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide silver ear cuff, three smaller silver rings, two thick silver bars and a small silver stud up to the top; one small silver stud sits in the right ear; four silver pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small silver rings pass through the left nostril and a thick silver septum ring hangs below the nose; a silver hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a silver snake-bite ring beside it and a small silver ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a silver Medusa stud sits above the lips; a silver labret stud and a small silver ring sit on the chin; three small silver studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small diamonds set into the metal.
#1 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, with spiral resist motifs filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Spanish woman — dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick silver septum ring with a smaller silver ring above it and two silver rings through each nostril; a straight silver bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three silver pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a silver Medusa stud above the lips; a big silver hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a silver labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small silver studs along each jaw; a curved row of small silver studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized silver hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine silver chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#2 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

#3: A striking adult woman — THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, soft pastel-peach hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a bold, commanding expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#3 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick silver septum ring with a smaller silver ring above it and two silver rings through each nostril; a straight silver bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three silver pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a silver Medusa stud above the lips; a big silver hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a silver labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small silver studs along each jaw; a curved row of small silver studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized silver hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine silver chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#3 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with one material instead of ordinary skin: traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, phoenix solo formations in VIVID CRIMSON and ELECTRIC GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Pose: each woman faces the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level. Generous spacing so every face reads clearly.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
